title: Kwaza language
extract: Kwaza is an endangered Amazonian language spoken by 25 of the Kwaza people of Brazil. Kwaza is an unclassified language. It has grammatical similarities with neighboring Aikanã and Kanoê, but it is not yet clear wherher this is due to a genealogical relationship or to contact.
